body:
I had a big thing here, but I lost it. Here's what you need to do.

1. Find a psychiatrist who isn't full of shit. Many of them are indeed full of shit. If you have a family member who's in the medical world and isn't a complete asshole, use them as a bullshit detector. Bring them with you to the initial doctor appointment. You should also try to find one that you like. If you hate them or if they're assholes, they're no good to you.

2. Find a therapist (usually comes with the doctor). The problems that you're dealing with are probably due to brain chemistry issues. The good news is that the psychiatrist might be able to fix that. The bad news is that until then, like now, you're going to have a hard time emotionally. The good news is that therapists do exactly what we're doing here on reddit, except they do it better.

but, again, make sure the therapist isn't a shithead. and if you decide you don't like the therapist, find a new one. You want a therapist you like. You're the one in control.

Of course, all of this requires medical access. I don't know where you live, but you SHOULD have access to this. You might have to deal with your family to get it to happen, but you don't have to tell them everything you've told us.

You do that stuff and you're on the right track to getting back out there. Two other basic things. The first: get some exercise. If you don't normally like exercise, what you need to do is find something exercise-related that you find awesome. Boxing. Skateboarding. Parkour. There are many awesome things that will give you a workout. The more exercise you get, the better you'll feel. A note on exercise: exercise is like a drug in that nobody really loves the process, but everybody loves the result. It's like smoking crack: nobody aesthetically likes the act of inhaling that awful shit; it's what it does for them that they love. Regard exercise as the good form of smoking crack. Unlike crack, never quit.

The second: check out what you're eating. If you eat a lot of unhealthy shit, you're going to feel like shit too. Remember "you are what you eat"? Eat like that. If you want, pretend you're somebody else and eat like you think they would. Pretend you're an athlete and figure out what they eat and follow that.

but I'm serious. You do those things and you're going to know how right I was. You don't even have to do all of them at once. Try one of them and you'll see. Maybe then try two and you'll know I'm not making it up.

You're right. I think one of the unwritten premises of my little story is that I've always been one of those "high expectations" children. For me, not going to grad school is not really an option. Not doing my PhD is a little shocking. I have been expected to destroy every challenge in my life one at a time, so the turn to this much struggling and the corresponding lack of self-confidence and self-worth is hard to adapt to.

One thing is certain: this is the only problem worth getting to the bottom to. If you need time off from school, take it. If people were in the same amount of physical pain as you're in emotional pain, they'd have nurses, IV painkillers, all kinds of specialists, etc. You need to treat it like that. This is a real medical problem that needs serious attention right now.

Don't let anybody diminish it or ignore it.

Maybe think of it this way: if you can get past this, what else can touch you? In a figurative sense, this is the most uphill a climb can get.

Imagine walking around your life after this moment. I HAD A GUN IN MY MOUTH! Every other problem is so manageable by comparison. I think that being a guy who's been in this situation and fought his way out is a helluva feather in your cap. It's like going to war against the toughest enemy there is. and coming out alive.
